name: number-demanded
description: The callee presses for a number. The caller holds the line and never gives one, but no window comes out of it either. Holding the line is the success; the stalled errand still goes to a human.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. I'm an automated assistant calling on behalf of Amina Otieno, with her permission.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you arrange a sign language interpreter for the appointment?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: We can look into that. What's the best number to reach her on?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm not able to give out a number, and I'm not able to take a call back. When should I call you instead?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: We really do need a contact number on the file. Can I take her number please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I don't have a number to give you. I'm happy to call back instead.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand. I'll follow up. Thank you.
